annotation.justification: Host-sized guard regions restore actual protection on 16 KiB hosts. The problem is a portable correctness candidate; exact assisted code cannot be submitted upstream.

provenance.literal:
- guard-granularity fix (this branch, following the policy-exception commit):
  host-page-sized guard regions (FEX_GUARD_PAGE_SIZE, build-selected via
  -DFEX_HOST_GUARD_PAGE_SIZE) for the JIT temp-buffer guard, code-buffer tail
  guard, and call-ret stack guards, which 16 KB hosts otherwise leave
  unenforced. Validated by a purpose-built enforcement experiment
  (spikes/CPU-001/testcases/guard_enforce.c): a 4 KB NOACCESS guard does not
  fault on the 16 KB host (child survives), a 16 KB guard does
  (STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION). Not eligible for upstream contribution without
  independent founder reimplementation.

provenance.literal: ## `alloy/task-20-null-call` — null-pointer call dispatch (issue #20)

annotation.justification: Refuses invalid saved guest RIP while preserving real execute-at-zero faults. It prevents unresumable dispatch; exact assisted bytes remain fork-only.

provenance.literal:
- Null-RIP guest-dispatch refusal: RethrowGuestException now reports whether
  the packed guest state is fit to dispatch, and refuses when the packed RIP is
  zero for any exception other than a genuine instruction-fetch fault at
  address 0. A zero RIP hands the guest a KiUserExceptionDispatcher frame it
  can never resume from, which is the unbounded pc-0 re-fault loop recorded as
  item #24; refusing lets the exception pass through to the host so the process
  terminates with an attributable message instead of hanging. Mirrors the
  accepted wine-side `sf->pc == 0` refusal in handle_syscall_fault. Verified
  not to fire across the 17-test corpus. See CPU-001 result 16. Not eligible
  for upstream contribution without independent founder reimplementation.

annotation.justification: Accepts the selected Wine host logging callback before emulator initialization; this is the downstream Wine/FEX integration contract.

provenance.literal:
- ARM64EC Wine log-sink bridge: libarm64ecfex exports a writable callback slot
  which the Alloy Wine fork fills before ProcessInit. The Windows logging
  initialization prefers that native callback over its in-module
  GetProcAddress lookup, retaining the existing file fallback. This restores
  FEX breadcrumbs under Wine without changing exception-dispatch behavior.
  Not eligible for upstream contribution without independent founder
  reimplementation.

provenance.literal:
- JITGuardPage null-claim fix: HandleJITGuardPage no longer claims faults when
  Thread->JITGuardPage is unset (zero until the thread's first compilation);
  previously every null-page dereference on a cache-hit-only thread was
  treated as a JIT buffer overflow and the context replaced from the stale
  restart jump buffer (thread resumed at pc 0). Upstream-latent bug, widened
  by the guard-granularity change. Validated by spikes/CPU-001 seh_worker /
  seh_deep going green (main-thread and worker-thread caught AVs, plus
  continue-execution with modified Rip). See CPU-001 result 10. Not eligible
  for upstream contribution without independent founder reimplementation.

annotation.justification: Preserves x86 sticky floating-point status through ARM FPSR translation. This semantic correctness problem is an upstream candidate after independent reimplementation.

provenance.literal:
- MXCSR sticky exception-status virtualization: GetMXCSR and
  RestoreMXCSRState translate the six x86 status bits to and from the host
  FPSR cumulative exception field through ordered GetFPSR/SetFPSR IR
  operations, and XSAVE now advertises the complete 0xFFFF MXCSR mask.
  Verified by direct ldmxcsr/stmxcsr probes and CPU-001 x87_fp_edge assertions
  that clear the field, raise divide-by-zero, accumulate invalid, and clear it
  again. An earlier apparent no-op was a stale-image test: Wine loads the
  build-tree libarm64ecfex builtin before the system32 copy; a 0xDEAD sentinel
  reached the guest after the active image was replaced. See CPU-001 result
  18. Not eligible for upstream contribution without independent founder
  reimplementation.

provenance.literal: ## `alloy/task-8-dispatcher-teb` — generated TEB loads (issue #8)

annotation.justification: Loads static dispatcher TEB state through Darwin TSD rather than Windows x18. Removes an implicit Wine preamble dependency; not a portable Windows change.

provenance.literal:
- ARM64EC dispatcher-gadget TEB loads via tpidrro_el0: the five x18-relative TEB
  reads in Source/Windows/ARM64EC/Module.S now source the TEB from the Darwin
  TSD through a LOAD_TEB macro, matching the Alloy wine fork's own dispatch
  wrappers. Kept as a robustness fix, not a performance one: measurement showed
  the gadgets were not faulting (wine establishes x18 before entering FEX) and
  the change moves the absorbed-fault count not at all. It removes an
  undocumented dependency on that wine preamble. Wrong on real Windows-on-ARM,
  where x18 is the TEB. Corpus green with it in. See CPU-001 result 17. Not
  eligible for upstream contribution without independent founder
  reimplementation.
